response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total FROM telescope_counts), shares AS (SELECT tc.observstation, tc.telescope_count, (100.0 * tc.telescope_count / (SELECT total FROM total_count)) as share FROM telescope_counts tc), avg_share_value AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), filtered AS (SELECT s.telescope_count, s.share FROM shares s WHERE s.share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_value)) SELECT AVG(telescope_count) as avg_telescope_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_value) as avg_excess FROM filtered;

assumptions.assumption: At least one telescope exists in the database. The shares CTE divides telescope counts by the total; if no telescopes exist, this will fail.
